Subject: Post-demo: DPA routing and SCC module preference — next steps

Hi Oliver / PriMed security team,

Thanks again for taking the time to walk through the demo today — appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep procurement moving: 

Key compliance notes from our side:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II audit in progress; we expect the final report to be available by Q4 2026. I attached a short summary and the auditor engagement stub for your security intake.
- GDPR / DPA: We route GDPR obligations via a standard DPA. For most customers the right path is Module A (Controller-to-Processor) but we can confirm after you confirm the data roles.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports BAA conversations for PHI-bearing workloads; we didn't scope that in today's demo but happy to connect legal if needed.

Immediate asks / next steps (my suggested sequencing):
1) Please confirm whether PriMed will act as Controller for the use case discussed (expected) and whether you prefer Module A (Controller->Processor) or want to evaluate Processor->Processor variants.
2) I attached our draft DPA (redwood_dpa_draft_v1.pdf) — please upload any redlines to the Drive link or return the marked-up doc.
3) I'll share the SOC 2 summary (attached) and a link to our secure evidence portal once the Type II is finalized.
4) I've started the vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) entry for PriMed. If you prefer, we can accept your completed VSQ attachment instead.

Attachments: redwood_dpa_draft_v1.pdf, SOC2-summary-stub.pdf

Proposed timeline:
- You confirm controller/processor roles and SCC module preference by EOD next week (Aug 28).
- We incorporate simple redlines and aim to return countersigned DPA within two weeks once roles are confirmed.

I'll loop in Rishi on commercial timeline if you want a dedicated point for contracting. Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Best,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Ava — great recap. A couple quick clarifications from PriMed's side: 

- Controller/Processor: PriMed will be the Controller for customer data in this deployment. We expect Redwood to act as the Processor. Please confirm you can accept that as Processor and sign the DPA in the Processor slot.
- SCC module: If that maps to Controller->Processor module, we prefer that option (your Module A) — please confirm the exact module name you reference so our legal team can map it.
- SOC2 evidence: we'll need the Type II once available; in the interim can you share the current SOC2 scope and whether any open exceptions exist?
- Vendor security questionnaire: attaching a marked version of our intake (PriMed_DPA_marked_up.docx) with a few DPA-specific redlines and our VSQ (VSQ_v1.xlsx). We typically route redlines through DocuSign or a shared Drive link — whichever is easiest for you.

If you can confirm the module name and that Redwood accepts Processor role, we'll stage redlines and aim to get them back by Friday Aug 28.

Thanks,
